name: Cotton to Freaks
summary:
The air is heavy with a sense of dread this evening. No doubt your decisions tonight will decide who will live to see daybreak. The evil out tonight has driven many to your saloon in search of shelter, but you must be wary of the panicked folk who beg you to let them in, for disguised among them are agents of the devil who wish to bring an end to you and your peers.

Consult the bestiary at your disposal to tell friend from foe, let your allies in and banish the impostors, but know that using the wrong banishment tool will result in a swift end to your life. Learn what makes the beasts tick through tests and questions and what is simply regular folk with odd dispositions. Save enough allies and you might just survive the night. Good luck, partner.
